title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00108 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: POOH w/ 5 stands to 2137m
00:45 - 02:30: Circulated out excess cement 3500lpm. After 132m3 pumped diverted returns to wash pill slop pit. Could not clearly identify cement in the returns. After 90m3 pumped diverted flow into active pit. Totally circulated 288m3
02:30 - 06:00: POOH w/ DP and EZSV setting tool
06:00 - 11:15: WOC, meanwhile worked on wellbore assemblies, prepared for the next run. Performed rig floor inspection and maintenance
11:15 - 12:00: P/u and m/u tagging BHA and RIH from surface to 81m
12:00 - 12:15: Changed out master bushing to ps21
12:15 - 12:30: RIH w/ tagging BHA from 81 to 140m. Met restriction 140m, hanger area
12:30 - 15:00: M/u TDS, milled hanger area 100-140 RPM/1500 LPM/1 bar/1-2t wob. Pipe stalled several times 20knm. Pulled up to 15t to free pipe. Removed ps21 due to vibration of the pipe
15:00 - 16:00: Performed drops inspection on TDS. Installed ps21
16:00 - 17:45: RIH on drill pipe from 140m to 1375m
17:45 - 18:00: Encountered restriction 1375m pulled 40t overpull to free pipe. M/u TDS, established parameters 1500 LPM/4 bar/80 RPM/3-6KNM
18:00 - 20:00: Milled through restriction from 1375 to 1377m 2000 LPM/12 bar/120 RPM
20:00 - 22:30: RIH on drill pipe from 1377 m to 2099 m. Encountered top of cement 2099 m
22:30 - 23:15: Dressed off 0,7 1 m 120 RPM/ 2000 LPM/6-12KNM. Tagged top of cement w/ 10 t 2100 m.
23:15 - 00:00: POOH w/ tagging BHA from 2100 m to 1830 m
